# Practical Automation Lab — Nano-paid APIs

PAL exposes deterministic commerce-data utilities for software agents. No account is required.

Base URL: https://pal-catalog-check-app.onrender.com
Network: nano:mainnet
Asset: XNO
Active receiver: nano_1gcpoxg6o1heqtmub9srjbpdwoe9bm1n85tks3yznjhb9iywktixczc7ydpr
Discovery: GET /api/nano/manifest

## Payment flow

1. POST the JSON body to a paid endpoint without a payment header.
2. The server answers HTTP 402 with pay_to, amount_raw, amount_xno and request_sha256.
3. Send exactly the quoted XNO amount to pay_to.
4. Retry the identical JSON body with:
   X-Nano-Payment: <64-character confirmed Nano send-block hash>
5. A successful paid call answers 200. A payment hash is bound to the request and endpoint; changed-body or cross-endpoint reuse is rejected.

This service never asks for a Nano seed or private key.

## POST /api/nano/catalog-audit

Price: 0.01 XNO per call.
Body:
{"products":[{"id":"sku-1","title":"Example","link":"https://example.com/p/1","image_link":"https://example.com/i/1.jpg","price":"19.99 USD","availability":"in_stock","brand":"Example","gtin":"4006381333931"}]}

Up to 100 products. Returns row-level catalog issues, summary and score.

## POST /api/nano/gtin-check

Price: 0.01 XNO per call.
Body:
{"gtins":["4006381333931","036000291452"]}

Up to 100 identifiers. Validates GTIN-8, GTIN/UPC-12, GTIN-13 and GTIN-14 lengths and check digits.

## POST /api/nano/feed-diff

Price: 0.01 XNO per call.
Body:
{"before":[{"id":"sku-1","price":"19.99 USD","availability":"in_stock"}],"after":[{"id":"sku-1","price":"17.99 USD","availability":"out_of_stock"}]}

Up to 100 rows per snapshot. Reports added IDs, removed IDs and changed commerce fields.
